#!/opt/homebrew/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

NAME="${1:-world}"
readonly DIR=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)

# a comment
main() {
  local n=0
  for f in "$DIR"/*.txt; do
    if [[ -r "$f" ]]; then
      n=$((n + 1))
      echo "hello $NAME: $f" >&2
    fi
  done
  printf '%d files\n' "$n"
  case "$NAME" in
    a|b) echo ab ;;
    *)   echo other ;;
  esac
}

main "$@"
